opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers toward OneCoin registration through paid membership packages, token allocations, and a mining-based route to projected earnings. It identifies a €100 starter package and links package tokens to mining and resulting coins, while assigning the mined coin a monetary value and presenting a €28,000 OneCoin portfolio example. Its compensation materials describe two-team recruitment, bonuses tied to package and team activity, and percentage payments connected to signing people. Although the presentation says outcomes are not guaranteed and projections depend on member engagement, those qualifications do not remove the underlying paid-return structure. References to public figures and KYC describe context only and do not establish endorsement or misuse.
